hotels.title: Gold Coast Luxe Self-Contained Two-Bedroom Apartment Stay Overlooking Kirra Beach
hotels.description: X marks the spot for your new favourite family escape at X Kirra Apartments, perfectly positioned on the Gold Coast's sparkling southernmost shores. Each two-bedroom apartment offers light-filled luxe living and spectacular views over the Pacific Ocean or hinterland. Beaming above the glossy sands of Kirra Beach, just moments from world-class surf, top-notch dining and the Gold Coast Airport, this sophisticated complex will be your home-away-from-home when exploring the region's extraordinary natural wonders and theme parks. Each self-contained apartment has first-class features, including fully equipped kitchens, sleek ensuites and expansive balconies framing postcard ocean or hinterland views, while the complex's heated swimming pool invites year-round relaxation. For family-friendly adventure, head to the nearby Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary and get to know the emus, koalas and crocodiles.
